title: Statement and Payment Terms for Outpatient and Part B Therapy Services Charges
content:
Resident charges for **Outpatient and Part B Therapy Services** are billed by the central business office on the following terms, which are the same in every tier.

| Tier | Billing cycle | Statement day of the month | Payment due | Accepted payment methods |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Medicare Part B Physical Therapy Plan of Care | Monthly in arrears | 6 | 30 calendar days after the statement date | Check, ACH, card, trust transfer |
| Medicare Part B Occupational Therapy Plan of Care | Monthly in arrears | 6 | 30 calendar days after the statement date | Check, ACH, card, trust transfer |
| Medicare Part B Speech-Language Pathology Plan of Care | Monthly in arrears | 6 | 30 calendar days after the statement date | Check, ACH, card, trust transfer |
| Medicare Advantage Outpatient Therapy Plan of Care | Monthly in arrears | 6 | 30 calendar days after the statement date | Check, ACH, card, trust transfer |
| Medical Assistance Therapy Plan of Care | Monthly in arrears | 6 | 30 calendar days after the statement date | Check, ACH, card, trust transfer |
| Private Pay Therapy Plan of Care | Monthly in arrears | 6 | 30 calendar days after the statement date | Check, ACH, card, trust transfer |

## Terms

1. Resident therapy charges are billed monthly in arrears: on the 6th day of each month, the prior month's resident therapy charges are billed.
2. Charges are due within 30 calendar days after the statement date.
3. Therapy charges may be paid by check, ACH, card or trust transfer.

## Illustration (hypothetical month)

Charges for visits furnished during a hypothetical month of July appear on the statement dated 6 August, and are due within 30 calendar days after 6 August.
